newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: BPI aims for leadership following merger.
newsitem.headline: BPI aims for leadership following merger.

text.p: Bank of the Philippine Islands said on Tuesday it would fight for market leadership in the local banking industry following the merger with CityTrust Banking Corp which took effect Monday.
"We're putting this together to take a leadership role in all businesses," BPI president Xavier Loinaz told a news conference.

BPI officials said the merger would enable BPI, a leader in electronic banking, to take a dominant role in consumer banking. CityTrust catered to the upper scale market in consumer banking, while BPI's savings bank tapped the low income market.

Xavier said the merger resulted in an increase in BPI's assets to 170 billion from some 130 billion pesos. BPI, however, still ranks third in terms of total assets in the banking industry next to Philippine National Bank which has assets of 180 billion pesos and Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co with assets of 191 billion pesos.
In terms of capital, BPI now ranks second with 20 billion pesos compared to Metrobank's 26 billion pesos.
BPI officials said they would not undertake a downsizing of the workforce as a result of the merger which now number 8,000 people. - Manila newsroom 63 2 841-8937 fax 8176267
